newsitem.title: USA: Dana Corp to export axles to Japan.
newsitem.headline: Dana Corp to export axles to Japan.

text.p: Dana Corp said its Spicer Axle division will manufacture axles for export to Japan for the first time under deals with Isuzu Motor Ltd and Honda Motor Co Ltd.
Dana said its Spicer division was selected recently as a supplier of rear axles for the 1998 Isuzu Trooper/Big Horn and Acura SLX, which will be built in Japan.
Production began last month with annual volumes expected to be 65,000 units. Other terms were not disclosed.
The axles are being assembled at Spicer's Columbia, Mo., regional assembly facility, the company said.
Once they arrive in Japan, Dana's Japanese affiliate, Najico Spicer Co Ltd inspects the axles, which are then delivered to Isuzu on a just-in-time basis.
